assets.name: Certificate service logic
assets.description: Handles every certificate request: checks it, stores it and passes approved ones to the key service.
assets.reason: It is the portal’s own service and every certificate request passes through it.
assets.would_change: A document that says this component is handled differently.

C.reason: Certificate service logic holds data that only the right people may read, and no other row covers it.

I.reason: An unauthorised change to certificate service logic would change what the portal issues, stores or shows.

A.reason: If certificate service logic stops, issuing, checking or revoking certificates stops with it.

Au.reason: No one relies on proving where certificate service logic comes from.

Az.reason: Certificate service logic decides or depends on who may do what; a missing check here is an Authorization problem (D-22).

NR.reason: Nothing done through certificate service logic needs to be proven afterwards.
